title: USGS Significant Earthquakes Feed
description: Daily USGS feed of M4.5+ earthquakes globally with economic-zone tagging. Each event is classified by proximity to major economic zones (Japan electronics/auto, Chile copper, Indonesia rare-earth/nickel, California tech/real-estate, Turkey/NATO flank, Pacific NW Cascadia, Italy/Mediterranean, New Zealand, Mexico manufacturing, Philippines BPO/semicon). Severity tier (LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/CRITICAL) is derived from magnitude, USGS PAGER alert color, and significance score. Feeds the Global Macro Risk Brief alert group for reinsurance, commodity-supply, and country-ETF trade ideas. Free USGS Earthquake Hazards Program API, no auth required.
